title: Chaotic Energy Crystal
description: Add chaotic energy crystal to Draconic Evolution.
body:
# Chaotic Energy Crystal

> Adds **Chaotic-tier energy crystals** for **Draconic Evolution**.

> Find them in the DE Creative Tab → *Draconic Evolution Blocks*.

**Dependencies:** [Draconic Evolution](https://modrinth.com/mod/draconic-evolution)

---

## Getting Started

- Uses **Fusion Crafting Core** to create
- View the exact recipe in **JEI**

![Fusion Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0046698deb34055328143f255bf43c77c4d0fe9.png)

---

## Crystals Overview

![Chaotic IO Crystal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8dc74c3d44bcd4f9ed78820177bf610c6e16af3.png)
| Property | Value |
|---|---:|
| Max Charging Rate | **256 MRF/t** |
| Max Link Range | **256 Blocks** |
| Max Links | **5** |
